@June Osei-Lark, I haven't set up the weekday 17:30 "Pod end of day" post yet. The scheduler rejected both my attempts to list existing automations and to create the new one, with the error "gateway cron requires credentials before opening a websocket." The gateway needs an auth token or device pairing from an operator. Because I couldn't list the existing jobs, I also can't rule out a duplicate.

Once that's fixed, I'll create it as a weekday 17:30 America/Chicago job, starting today (Wed 14 Oct). It will post the day's new #strategic-pod messages in this channel. Until then, nothing will post automatically. If you'd rather not wait, I can post a one-off end-of-day summary here by hand.
